method: Read-only source and exact-artifact review, independent of the author. No heavy source process was rerun.

findings.finding: The private current state supplies Sigma, the original literal H integrals and the unchanged positive square-root amplitudes. The code accepts no caller-supplied target or replacement positive amplitude. Delta a equals H inverse of Sigma/epsilon divided by 2a.

All six harmonic covariances retain the cosine/sine half factor. The two original H columns are checked as the same actual integrals, not merely equal labels. Positivity definitions a^2=y and sqrt(epsilon)^2=epsilon remain explicit. The complete original squared partition and exact physical exponent identity connect all81 contributions.

The actual full curls are retained before angular and auxiliary integration. With U=W+E and V=L+R, C(U+V)-C(U)=B(W,L)+B(E,L)+B(U,R)+C(V). Each of the last three terms has a complete guarded81-label indexed system; the increment square and both signs are retained. Generic omission tests make every component fail for nonzero independent vectors.

The current covariance is a complete physical field, differentiated with each physical label fixed. The full radial primitives are not evaluated from a point inventory. Under a reference-chart change, the radial measure, rho normalization and entire c_rho*P pressure product give the same exponent2A for both components of Sigma. Reindexing nearest-label lists does not differentiate floors.

All six updated auxiliary means feed the same compact pressure, P/J moments and weighted radial residual constructor. The exported derivative audit follows both original variational systems and retains all81 candidates and complete coefficient/time derivative bodies. Every original-current source-prefix byte and private seal remains unchanged.

limits: Uniform all-order class bounds are not supplied by the generic variational exp(KL) tail or by these finite derivatives.
The original initialized j=0 state, full nonzero auxiliary pressure and every finite correction stage remain outstanding.

This verifies actual function-expression construction and algebra. It does not compute numerical values of the full field, complete original N6-04, prove the full Navier construction, or run a new Lean theorem.
